# Some coins misbehave in the cave

### What happens
`recording.mp4` is an uncut run through a cave basin. Twice during the clip, Tux does something that releases a group of new coins. From the first of those moments until the end of the clip, the released coins do not behave the way coins in this game should. The coins that were already placed in the level, Tux, the animals and the scenery in the recording are correct.

### Expected
Each group of released coins should behave like a normal coin burst in this game, from the moment they spread out of their block until they come to rest and Tux goes back to collect them. Once a coin is within the basin's surrounding environment, it should drift down slowly, from the moment it enters it. Fix every way the released coins behave wrongly in the recording.

## Attached visual evidence

- `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4` (47 seconds)

You can inspect individual moments of the video by extracting frames from it with `ffmpeg`.

Inspect the attached file before making changes.=== task.toml ===

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Turns the game logs written by the four HeavyCoin test levels into JUnit testcases.
+
+usage: evaluate_heavycoin.py <water.log> <burst.log> <repeat.log> <offscreen.log> <junit.xml> [test ids...]
+
+heavycoin_water_test.stl (32px tiles, sampled every 0.1 simulated seconds for 30 seconds):
+  y in [0, 96)     air
+  y in [96, 416)   water, 10 tiles deep; solid floor from y=416
+  y ~= 384         where a coin comes to rest on that floor
+  "COINY i y"      a coin dropped from the air (y=16) that hits the water already falling fast
+  "RESTY i y"      a coin placed inside the water (y=112), starting at rest
+
+heavycoin_burst_test.stl (dry room, flat floor, walls ~2200px to each side):
+  Tux bumps a coin-burst bonus block from below and is parked in a sealed pocket. Eight seconds
+  later he sweeps the floor zone by zone and each "ZONE <name> <n>" line reports how many coins
+  he picked up there. Zones are measured from the block's centre: center (within 64px),
+  left_in / right_in (80..1000px), left_out / right_out (beyond 1016px, up to the walls).
+  The block throws 10 coins.
+
+heavycoin_repeat_test.stl (dry room like the burst room, open sky above it):
+  Two coin-burst blocks 2176px apart. Tux bumps the first, is parked, bumps the second three
+  seconds later and is parked again. Eight seconds after the second burst he sweeps the floor
+  within 1000px of each block; "RZONE first <n>" / "RZONE second <n>" report the pickups.
+
+heavycoin_offscreen_test.stl (dry shaft 3840px tall, floor from y=3680):
+  Tux is parked in a pocket at the top, so the camera shows only the top of the shaft. A coin is
+  dropped near the bottom, far out of view; "FARY i y" samples it every 0.1s for 4s ("GONE" once
+  it no longer exists). Then Tux is moved onto it and "FAR_PICKED <n>" reports what he collected.
+"""
+import re
+import sys
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+WATER_TOP = 96.0
+FLOOR_REST = 384.0
+SHAFT_REST = 3648.0
+
+
+def parse_series(path, tag):
+    out = {}
+    pat = re.compile(tag + r" (-?\d+) (-?[0-9.]+)")
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = pat.search(line)
+            if m:
+                out[int(m.group(1))] = float(m.group(2))
+    return out
+
+
+def parse_lines(path, pat):
+    out = {}
+    rx = re.compile(pat)
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = rx.search(line)
+            if m:
+                out[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    return out
+
+
+def upto(series, last):
+    vals = [series.get(i) for i in range(last + 1)]
+    return None if any(v is None for v in vals) else vals
+
+
+def main():
+    water_log, burst_log, repeat_log, offscreen_log, junit_path = sys.argv[1:6]
+    requested = sys.argv[6:]
+
+    drop = parse_series(water_log, "COINY")
+    rest = parse_series(water_log, "RESTY")
+    zones = {k: int(v) for k, v in parse_lines(burst_log, r"ZONE (\w+) (-?\d+)").items()}
+    sys.stderr.write("drop: %r\nrest: %r\nzones: %r\n" % (sorted(drop.items()), sorted(rest.items()), zones))
+
+    results = []  # (test id, passed, message)
+    have_water = len(drop) >= 300 and len(rest) >= 300
+    have_burst = all(k in zones for k in ("center", "left_in", "right_in", "left_out", "right_out"))
+
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.produces_trajectory", have_water,
+                    "expected >=300 samples per coin, got drop=%d rest=%d" % (len(drop), len(rest))))
+
+    y2 = drop.get(2)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.still_falling_before_water",
+                    have_water and y2 is not None and y2 < WATER_TOP,
+                    "dropped coin y at t=0.2s = %r (expected < %.0f, still in the air)" % (y2, WATER_TOP)))
+
+    first_1s = upto(drop, 10)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.floats_in_water_by_1s",
+                    have_water and first_1s is not None and max(first_1s) < 300.0,
+                    "dropped coin y over t=0..1.0s = %r (expected to stay < 300: a coin that hits the "
+                    "water while falling fast should be slowed down instead of reaching the floor "
+                    "region at y~%.0f)" % (first_1s, FLOOR_REST)))
+
+    first_16 = upto(drop, 16)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.still_sinking_at_1_6s",
+                    have_water and first_16 is not None and max(first_16) < FLOOR_REST - 10,
+                    "dropped coin y over t=0..1.6s = %r (expected to stay < %.0f: about a second after "
+                    "hitting the water it should still be drifting down through the pool, not resting "
+                    "on the floor)" % (first_16, FLOOR_REST - 10)))
+
+    rest_1s = upto(rest, 10)
+    r10, r25 = rest.get(10), rest.get(25)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.sinks_slowly_from_rest",
+                    have_water and rest_1s is not None and max(rest_1s) < FLOOR_REST - 16
+                    and r10 is not None and r25 is not None and r25 - r10 >= 16.0,
+                    "submerged coin y over t=0..1.0s = %r (expected to stay < %.0f), y(1.0s)=%r, "
+                    "y(2.5s)=%r (expected to have sunk at least 16px further: it keeps sinking)"
+                    % (rest_1s, FLOOR_REST - 16, r10, r25)))
+
+    late = {}
+    for name, series in (("dropped", drop), ("submerged", rest)):
+        vals = [series.get(i) for i in range(285, 300)]
+        late[name] = None if any(v is None for v in vals) else vals
+    settled = have_water and all(
+        v is not None and max(v) - min(v) <= 1.0 and min(v) >= FLOOR_REST - 4 for v in late.values())
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.coins_settle_on_floor", settled,
+                    "coin y over t=28.5..29.9s: %r (expected both coins to lie still on the pool floor "
+                    "at y~%.0f by then)" % (late, FLOOR_REST)))
+
+    total = sum(zones.values()) if have_burst else 0
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.released_coins_can_be_collected", have_burst and total >= 3,
+                    "zones=%r (expected Tux to pick up the released coins when he sweeps the floor: "
+                    ">= 3 picked up in total)" % (zones,)))
+
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.releases_full_burst",
+                    have_burst and total >= 9,
+                    "zones=%r: %d of the block's 10 coins ended up on the floor (expected >= 9: every "
+                    "coin of the burst is thrown out and comes down)" % (zones, total)))
+
+    left = zones.get("left_in", 0) + zones.get("left_out", 0)
+    right = zones.get("right_in", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.scatters_to_both_sides",
+                    have_burst and left >= 2 and right >= 2,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins landed clearly left of the block, %d clearly right of it "
+                    "(expected >= 2 on each side)" % (zones, left, right)))
+
+    far = zones.get("left_out", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.landed_coins_come_to_rest",
+                    have_burst and total >= 3 and far == 0,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins were found more than 1000px from the block 8 seconds after "
+                    "the burst (expected 0: a landed coin should come to rest instead of travelling on)" % (zones, far)))
+
+    rzones = {k: int(v) for k, v in parse_lines(repeat_log, r"RZONE (\w+) (-?\d+)").items()}
+    sys.stderr.write("repeat zones: %r\n" % (rzones,))
+    have_repeat = "first" in rzones and "second" in rzones
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.every_burst_comes_down",
+                    have_repeat and rzones["first"] >= 9 and rzones["second"] >= 9,
+                    "repeat zones=%r (expected >= 9 of the 10 coins of EACH burst to be picked up within "
+                    "1000px of its block 8s after the second burst: a burst behaves the same however many "
+                    "blocks were opened before it)" % (rzones,)))
+
+    far_coin = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"FARY (\d+) (\S+)")
+    picked = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"(FAR_PICKED) (-?\d+)").get("FAR_PICKED")
+    sys.stderr.write("far coin: %r picked=%r\n"
+                     % (sorted(far_coin.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])), picked))
+    far_vals = [far_coin.get(str(i)) for i in range(40)]
+    kept = all(v is not None and v != "GONE" for v in far_vals)
+    tail = [float(v) for v in far_vals[30:]] if kept else None
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinOffscreenTest.kept_while_out_of_view",
+                    kept and max(tail) - min(tail) <= 1.0 and abs(tail[-1] - SHAFT_REST) <= 4.0,
+                    "far coin y over 4s = %r (expected the coin to keep existing while it is out of the "
+                    "camera's view, and to lie on the shaft floor at y~%.0f from t=3s)" % (far_vals, SHAFT_REST)))
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinOffscreenTest.collected_after_coming_back",
+                    picked is not None and int(picked) == 1,
+                    "Tux picked up %r coins when he went down to the coin (expected 1)" % (picked,)))
+
+    if requested:
+        results = [r for r in results if r[0] in requested]
+
+    suite = ET.Element("testsuite", {
+        "name": "HeavyCoin",
+        "tests": str(len(results)),
+        "failures": str(sum(1 for _, ok, _ in results if not ok)),
+    })
+    for test_id, ok, message in results:
+        tc = ET.SubElement(suite, "testcase", {"classname": test_id.split(".")[0], "name": test_id})
+        if not ok:
+            failure = ET.SubElement(tc, "failure", {"message": "assertion failed"})
+            failure.text = message
+        sys.stderr.write("%s: %s -- %s\n" % (test_id, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", message))
+
+    ET.ElementTree(suite).write(junit_path, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)
+    sys.exit(1 if any(not ok for _, ok, _ in results) else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Turns the game logs written by the four HeavyCoin test levels into JUnit testcases.
+
+usage: evaluate_heavycoin.py <water.log> <burst.log> <repeat.log> <offscreen.log> <junit.xml> [test ids...]
+
+heavycoin_water_test.stl (32px tiles, sampled every 0.1 simulated seconds for 30 seconds):
+  y in [0, 96)     air
+  y in [96, 416)   water, 10 tiles deep; solid floor from y=416
+  y ~= 384         where a coin comes to rest on that floor
+  "COINY i y"      a coin dropped from the air (y=16) that hits the water already falling fast
+  "RESTY i y"      a coin placed inside the water (y=112), starting at rest
+
+heavycoin_burst_test.stl (dry room, flat floor, walls ~2200px to each side):
+  Tux bumps a coin-burst bonus block from below and is parked in a sealed pocket. Eight seconds
+  later he sweeps the floor zone by zone and each "ZONE <name> <n>" line reports how many coins
+  he picked up there. Zones are measured from the block's centre: center (within 64px),
+  left_in / right_in (80..1000px), left_out / right_out (beyond 1016px, up to the walls).
+  The block throws 10 coins.
+
+heavycoin_repeat_test.stl (dry room like the burst room, open sky above it):
+  Two coin-burst blocks 2176px apart. Tux bumps the first, is parked, bumps the second three
+  seconds later and is parked again. Eight seconds after the second burst he sweeps the floor
+  within 1000px of each block; "RZONE first <n>" / "RZONE second <n>" report the pickups.
+
+heavycoin_offscreen_test.stl (dry shaft 3840px tall, floor from y=3680):
+  Tux is parked in a pocket at the top, so the camera shows only the top of the shaft. A coin is
+  dropped near the bottom, far out of view; "FARY i y" samples it every 0.1s for 4s ("GONE" once
+  it no longer exists). Then Tux is moved onto it and "FAR_PICKED <n>" reports what he collected.
+"""
+import re
+import sys
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+WATER_TOP = 96.0
+FLOOR_REST = 384.0
+SHAFT_REST = 3648.0
+
+
+def parse_series(path, tag):
+    out = {}
+    pat = re.compile(tag + r" (-?\d+) (-?[0-9.]+)")
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = pat.search(line)
+            if m:
+                out[int(m.group(1))] = float(m.group(2))
+    return out
+
+
+def parse_lines(path, pat):
+    out = {}
+    rx = re.compile(pat)
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = rx.search(line)
+            if m:
+                out[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    return out
+
+
+def upto(series, last):
+    vals = [series.get(i) for i in range(last + 1)]
+    return None if any(v is None for v in vals) else vals
+
+
+def main():
+    water_log, burst_log, repeat_log, offscreen_log, junit_path = sys.argv[1:6]
+    requested = sys.argv[6:]
+
+    drop = parse_series(water_log, "COINY")
+    rest = parse_series(water_log, "RESTY")
+    zones = {k: int(v) for k, v in parse_lines(burst_log, r"ZONE (\w+) (-?\d+)").items()}
+    sys.stderr.write("drop: %r\nrest: %r\nzones: %r\n" % (sorted(drop.items()), sorted(rest.items()), zones))
+
+    results = []  # (test id, passed, message)
+    have_water = len(drop) >= 300 and len(rest) >= 300
+    have_burst = all(k in zones for k in ("center", "left_in", "right_in", "left_out", "right_out"))
+
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.produces_trajectory", have_water,
+                    "expected >=300 samples per coin, got drop=%d rest=%d" % (len(drop), len(rest))))
+
+    y2 = drop.get(2)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.still_falling_before_water",
+                    have_water and y2 is not None and y2 < WATER_TOP,
+                    "dropped coin y at t=0.2s = %r (expected < %.0f, still in the air)" % (y2, WATER_TOP)))
+
+    first_1s = upto(drop, 10)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.floats_in_water_by_1s",
+                    have_water and first_1s is not None and max(first_1s) < 300.0,
+                    "dropped coin y over t=0..1.0s = %r (expected to stay < 300: a coin that hits the "
+                    "water while falling fast should be slowed down instead of reaching the floor "
+                    "region at y~%.0f)" % (first_1s, FLOOR_REST)))
+
+    first_16 = upto(drop, 16)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.still_sinking_at_1_6s",
+                    have_water and first_16 is not None and max(first_16) < FLOOR_REST - 10,
+                    "dropped coin y over t=0..1.6s = %r (expected to stay < %.0f: about a second after "
+                    "hitting the water it should still be drifting down through the pool, not resting "
+                    "on the floor)" % (first_16, FLOOR_REST - 10)))
+
+    rest_1s = upto(rest, 10)
+    r10, r25 = rest.get(10), rest.get(25)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.sinks_slowly_from_rest",
+                    have_water and rest_1s is not None and max(rest_1s) < FLOOR_REST - 16
+                    and r10 is not None and r25 is not None and r25 - r10 >= 16.0,
+                    "submerged coin y over t=0..1.0s = %r (expected to stay < %.0f), y(1.0s)=%r, "
+                    "y(2.5s)=%r (expected to have sunk at least 16px further: it keeps sinking)"
+                    % (rest_1s, FLOOR_REST - 16, r10, r25)))
+
+    late = {}
+    for name, series in (("dropped", drop), ("submerged", rest)):
+        vals = [series.get(i) for i in range(285, 300)]
+        late[name] = None if any(v is None for v in vals) else vals
+    settled = have_water and all(
+        v is not None and max(v) - min(v) <= 1.0 and min(v) >= FLOOR_REST - 4 for v in late.values())
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.coins_settle_on_floor", settled,
+                    "coin y over t=28.5..29.9s: %r (expected both coins to lie still on the pool floor "
+                    "at y~%.0f by then)" % (late, FLOOR_REST)))
+
+    total = sum(zones.values()) if have_burst else 0
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.released_coins_can_be_collected", have_burst and total >= 3,
+                    "zones=%r (expected Tux to pick up the released coins when he sweeps the floor: "
+                    ">= 3 picked up in total)" % (zones,)))
+
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.releases_full_burst",
+                    have_burst and total >= 9,
+                    "zones=%r: %d of the block's 10 coins ended up on the floor (expected >= 9: every "
+                    "coin of the burst is thrown out and comes down)" % (zones, total)))
+
+    left = zones.get("left_in", 0) + zones.get("left_out", 0)
+    right = zones.get("right_in", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.scatters_to_both_sides",
+                    have_burst and left >= 2 and right >= 2,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins landed clearly left of the block, %d clearly right of it "
+                    "(expected >= 2 on each side)" % (zones, left, right)))
+
+    far = zones.get("left_out", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.landed_coins_come_to_rest",
+                    have_burst and total >= 3 and far == 0,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins were found more than 1000px from the block 8 seconds after "
+                    "the burst (expected 0: a landed coin should come to rest instead of travelling on)" % (zones, far)))
+
+    rzones = {k: int(v) for k, v in parse_lines(repeat_log, r"RZONE (\w+) (-?\d+)").items()}
+    sys.stderr.write("repeat zones: %r\n" % (rzones,))
+    have_repeat = "first" in rzones and "second" in rzones
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.every_burst_comes_down",
+                    have_repeat and rzones["first"] >= 9 and rzones["second"] >= 9,
+                    "repeat zones=%r (expected >= 9 of the 10 coins of EACH burst to be picked up within "
+                    "1000px of its block 8s after the second burst: a burst behaves the same however many "
+                    "blocks were opened before it)" % (rzones,)))
+
+    far_coin = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"FARY (\d+) (\S+)")
+    picked = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"(FAR_PICKED) (-?\d+)").get("FAR_PICKED")
+    sys.stderr.write("far coin: %r picked=%r\n"
+                     % (sorted(far_coin.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])), picked))
+    far_vals = [far_coin.get(str(i)) for i in range(40)]
+    kept = all(v is not None and v != "GONE" for v in far_vals)
+    tail = [float(v) for v in far_vals[30:]] if kept else None
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinOffscreenTest.kept_while_out_of_view",
+                    kept and max(tail) - min(tail) <= 1.0 and abs(tail[-1] - SHAFT_REST) <= 4.0,
+                    "far coin y over 4s = %r (expected the coin to keep existing while it is out of the "
+                    "camera's view, and to lie on the shaft floor at y~%.0f from t=3s)" % (far_vals, SHAFT_REST)))
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinOffscreenTest.collected_after_coming_back",
+                    picked is not None and int(picked) == 1,
+                    "Tux picked up %r coins when he went down to the coin (expected 1)" % (picked,)))
+
+    if requested:
+        results = [r for r in results if r[0] in requested]
+
+    suite = ET.Element("testsuite", {
+        "name": "HeavyCoin",
+        "tests": str(len(results)),
+        "failures": str(sum(1 for _, ok, _ in results if not ok)),
+    })
+    for test_id, ok, message in results:
+        tc = ET.SubElement(suite, "testcase", {"classname": test_id.split(".")[0], "name": test_id})
+        if not ok:
+            failure = ET.SubElement(tc, "failure", {"message": "assertion failed"})
+            failure.text = message
+        sys.stderr.write("%s: %s -- %s\n" % (test_id, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", message))
+
+    ET.ElementTree(suite).write(junit_path, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)
+    sys.exit(1 if any(not ok for _, ok, _ in results) else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+  he picked up there. Zones are measured from the block's centre: center (within 64px),
+  left_in / right_in (80..1000px), left_out / right_out (beyond 1016px, up to the walls).

+

+  Two coin-burst blocks 2176px apart. Tux bumps the first, is parked, bumps the second three
+  seconds later and is parked again. Eight seconds after the second burst he sweeps the floor
+  within 1000px of each block; "RZONE first <n>" / "RZONE second <n>" report the pickups.

+  Tux is parked in a pocket at the top, so the camera shows only the top of the shaft. A coin is

+    pat = re.compile(tag + r" (-?\d+) (-?[0-9.]+)")
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = pat.search(line)
+            if m:

+                    "blocks were opened before it)" % (rzones,)))

+    picked = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"(FAR_PICKED) (-?\d+)").get("FAR_PICKED")
+    sys.stderr.write("far coin: %r picked=%r\n"

+heavycoin_water_test.stl (32px tiles, sampled every 0.1 simulated seconds for 30 seconds):
+  y in [0, 96)     air
+  y in [96, 416)   water, 10 tiles deep; solid floor from y=416
+  y ~= 384         where a coin comes to rest on that floor
+  "COINY i y"      a coin dropped from the air (y=16) that hits the water already falling fast
+  "RESTY i y"      a coin placed inside the water (y=112), starting at rest
+
+heavycoin_burst_test.stl (dry room, flat floor, walls ~2200px to each side):
+  Tux bumps a coin-burst bonus block from below and is parked in a sealed pocket. Eight seconds
+  later he sweeps the floor zone by zone and each "ZONE <name> <n>" line reports how many coins
+  he picked up there. Zones are measured from the block's centre: center (within 64px),
+  left_in / right_in (80..1000px), left_out / right_out (beyond 1016px, up to the walls).
+  The block throws 10 coins.
+
+heavycoin_repeat_test.stl (dry room like the burst room, open sky above it):
+  Two coin-burst blocks 2176px apart. Tux bumps the first, is parked, bumps the second three
+  seconds later and is parked again. Eight seconds after the second burst he sweeps the floor
+  within 1000px of each block; "RZONE first <n>" / "RZONE second <n>" report the pickups.
+
+heavycoin_offscreen_test.stl (dry shaft 3840px tall, floor from y=3680):
+  Tux is parked in a pocket at the top, so the camera shows only the top of the shaft. A coin is
+  dropped near the bottom, far out of view; "FARY i y" samples it every 0.1s for 4s ("GONE" once
+  it no longer exists). Then Tux is moved onto it and "FAR_PICKED <n>" reports what he collected.
+"""
+import re
+import sys
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+WATER_TOP = 96.0
+FLOOR_REST = 384.0
+SHAFT_REST = 3648.0
+
+
+def parse_series(path, tag):
+    out = {}
+    pat = re.compile(tag + r" (-?\d+) (-?[0-9.]+)")
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = pat.search(line)
+            if m:
+                out[int(m.group(1))] = float(m.group(2))
+    return out
+
+
+def parse_lines(path, pat):
+    out = {}
+    rx = re.compile(pat)
+    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            m = rx.search(line)
+            if m:
+                out[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    return out
+
+
+def upto(series, last):
+    vals = [series.get(i) for i in range(last + 1)]
+    return None if any(v is None for v in vals) else vals
+
+
+def main():
+    water_log, burst_log, repeat_log, offscreen_log, junit_path = sys.argv[1:6]
+    requested = sys.argv[6:]
+
+    drop = parse_series(water_log, "COINY")
+    rest = parse_series(water_log, "RESTY")
+    zones = {k: int(v) for k, v in parse_lines(burst_log, r"ZONE (\w+) (-?\d+)").items()}
+    sys.stderr.write("drop: %r\nrest: %r\nzones: %r\n" % (sorted(drop.items()), sorted(rest.items()), zones))
+
+    results = []  # (test id, passed, message)
+    have_water = len(drop) >= 300 and len(rest) >= 300
+    have_burst = all(k in zones for k in ("center", "left_in", "right_in", "left_out", "right_out"))
+
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.produces_trajectory", have_water,
+                    "expected >=300 samples per coin, got drop=%d rest=%d" % (len(drop), len(rest))))
+
+    y2 = drop.get(2)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.still_falling_before_water",
+                    have_water and y2 is not None and y2 < WATER_TOP,
+                    "dropped coin y at t=0.2s = %r (expected < %.0f, still in the air)" % (y2, WATER_TOP)))
+
+    first_1s = upto(drop, 10)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.floats_in_water_by_1s",
+                    have_water and first_1s is not None and max(first_1s) < 300.0,
+                    "dropped coin y over t=0..1.0s = %r (expected to stay < 300: a coin that hits the "
+                    "water while falling fast should be slowed down instead of reaching the floor "
+                    "region at y~%.0f)" % (first_1s, FLOOR_REST)))
+
+    first_16 = upto(drop, 16)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.still_sinking_at_1_6s",
+                    have_water and first_16 is not None and max(first_16) < FLOOR_REST - 10,
+                    "dropped coin y over t=0..1.6s = %r (expected to stay < %.0f: about a second after "
+                    "hitting the water it should still be drifting down through the pool, not resting "
+                    "on the floor)" % (first_16, FLOOR_REST - 10)))
+
+    rest_1s = upto(rest, 10)
+    r10, r25 = rest.get(10), rest.get(25)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.sinks_slowly_from_rest",
+                    have_water and rest_1s is not None and max(rest_1s) < FLOOR_REST - 16
+                    and r10 is not None and r25 is not None and r25 - r10 >= 16.0,
+                    "submerged coin y over t=0..1.0s = %r (expected to stay < %.0f), y(1.0s)=%r, "
+                    "y(2.5s)=%r (expected to have sunk at least 16px further: it keeps sinking)"
+                    % (rest_1s, FLOOR_REST - 16, r10, r25)))
+
+    late = {}
+    for name, series in (("dropped", drop), ("submerged", rest)):
+        vals = [series.get(i) for i in range(285, 300)]
+        late[name] = None if any(v is None for v in vals) else vals
+    settled = have_water and all(
+        v is not None and max(v) - min(v) <= 1.0 and min(v) >= FLOOR_REST - 4 for v in late.values())
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinWaterTest.coins_settle_on_floor", settled,
+                    "coin y over t=28.5..29.9s: %r (expected both coins to lie still on the pool floor "
+                    "at y~%.0f by then)" % (late, FLOOR_REST)))
+
+    total = sum(zones.values()) if have_burst else 0
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.released_coins_can_be_collected", have_burst and total >= 3,
+                    "zones=%r (expected Tux to pick up the released coins when he sweeps the floor: "
+                    ">= 3 picked up in total)" % (zones,)))
+
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.releases_full_burst",
+                    have_burst and total >= 9,
+                    "zones=%r: %d of the block's 10 coins ended up on the floor (expected >= 9: every "
+                    "coin of the burst is thrown out and comes down)" % (zones, total)))
+
+    left = zones.get("left_in", 0) + zones.get("left_out", 0)
+    right = zones.get("right_in", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.scatters_to_both_sides",
+                    have_burst and left >= 2 and right >= 2,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins landed clearly left of the block, %d clearly right of it "
+                    "(expected >= 2 on each side)" % (zones, left, right)))
+
+    far = zones.get("left_out", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.landed_coins_come_to_rest",
+                    have_burst and total >= 3 and far == 0,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins were found more than 1000px from the block 8 seconds after "
+                    "the burst (expected 0: a landed coin should come to rest instead of travelling on)" % (zones, far)))
+
+    rzones = {k: int(v) for k, v in parse_lines(repeat_log, r"RZONE (\w+) (-?\d+)").items()}
+    sys.stderr.write("repeat zones: %r\n" % (rzones,))
+    have_repeat = "first" in rzones and "second" in rzones
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.every_burst_comes_down",
+                    have_repeat and rzones["first"] >= 9 and rzones["second"] >= 9,
+                    "repeat zones=%r (expected >= 9 of the 10 coins of EACH burst to be picked up within "
+                    "1000px of its block 8s after the second burst: a burst behaves the same however many "
+                    "blocks were opened before it)" % (rzones,)))
+
+    far_coin = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"FARY (\d+) (\S+)")
+    picked = parse_lines(offscreen_log, r"(FAR_PICKED) (-?\d+)").get("FAR_PICKED")
+    sys.stderr.write("far coin: %r picked=%r\n"
+                     % (sorted(far_coin.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])), picked))
+    far_vals = [far_coin.get(str(i)) for i in range(40)]
+    kept = all(v is not None and v != "GONE" for v in far_vals)
+    tail = [float(v) for v in far_vals[30:]] if kept else None
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinOffscreenTest.kept_while_out_of_view",
+                    kept and max(tail) - min(tail) <= 1.0 and abs(tail[-1] - SHAFT_REST) <= 4.0,
+                    "far coin y over 4s = %r (expected the coin to keep existing while it is out of the "
+                    "camera's view, and to lie on the shaft floor at y~%.0f from t=3s)" % (far_vals, SHAFT_REST)))
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinOffscreenTest.collected_after_coming_back",
+                    picked is not None and int(picked) == 1,
+                    "Tux picked up %r coins when he went down to the coin (expected 1)" % (picked,)))
+
+    if requested:
+        results = [r for r in results if r[0] in requested]
+
+    suite = ET.Element("testsuite", {
+        "name": "HeavyCoin",
+        "tests": str(len(results)),
+        "failures": str(sum(1 for _, ok, _ in results if not ok)),
+    })
+    for test_id, ok, message in results:
+        tc = ET.SubElement(suite, "testcase", {"classname": test_id.split(".")[0], "name": test_id})
+        if not ok:
+            failure = ET.SubElement(tc, "failure", {"message": "assertion failed"})
+            failure.text = message
+        sys.stderr.write("%s: %s -- %s\n" % (test_id, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", message))
+
+    ET.ElementTree(suite).write(junit_path, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)
+    sys.exit(1 if any(not ok for _, ok, _ in results) else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
